required_evidence: Comparable human sensory outcomes across preparation families with coffee and major serving conditions controlled.
audit_finding: Existing aggregate contrasts are bounded by construct and confounding. Temperature within immersion and milk formulations alone do not close cross-family coverage.
next_action: Use existing lineage where applicable; acquire no duplicate aggregate simply to increase volume.

required_evidence: Reviewed crosswalk from exact source roast metric and specimen to seven product codes; preserve uncertainty and absent levels.
audit_finding: Source-local two or three roast levels and differing color instruments do not themselves supply the seven-level crosswalk.
next_action: Keep C1 adjustment zero; request a separately reviewable mapping specification using source roast metadata.

required_evidence: Observed joint context cells with same-study support and reviewed context mapping; no Cartesian expansion of marginal evidence.
audit_finding: Available crossed experiments are source-local, often within one preparation family or from ordinary consumers; no audited seven-level product joint matrix.
next_action: Retain joint eligibility as unknown until data rights, cell structure and mapping are independently reviewed.

required_evidence: Known presented descriptor set, valid response denominator, selection/nonselection semantics, missingness, sample context and study-local scope.
audit_finding: Aggregate intensity, low selection, omitted term, no selection, dislike and missing response cannot be interchanged or generalized to descriptor absence.
next_action: Import no negative labels; require an instrument-specific denominator and missingness audit before deriving any bounded nonselection evidence.

required_evidence: Human sensory contrasts aligned to project concepts while keeping intensity, selection frequency, quality and liking distinct.
audit_finding: Published differences are context-conditional and do not validate product salience ranks or ordinary-user interpretation of project question axes.
next_action: Reuse governed contrasts only under source roles; human comprehension and answer discrimination still need user testing.
